shared_elements: low-relief carving on a flat stone surface
repeated linear/geometric patterning (zigzags, chevrons, hatched bands)
horizontal register divided by a straight border line
justification: A depicts large-scale bearded human figures in profile with elaborately curled hair and beards, fringed garments and held objects, while B shows only an abstract ornamental frieze of repeated lobed/leaf-like motifs above a band of zigzag or chevron lattice, with an interlace border at the edge. The only real correspondence is the shared use of shallow relief carving with regularly repeated patterned bands (A's hair curls, fringes and hatched textile edges are also rendered as repetitive rows), which is far too generic to imply a shared iconographic scheme; no figures, creatures or specific motifs are held in common.
